notes.title: Alienate Live Stream - Re-Do 6/21/2020
notes.notes:
This live stream is going to give players and viewers an idea of what the game is going to be like. Keep in mind this is an alpha build, some content may be different in the final version. There were some technical problems which is why it got cancelled 6/19/20 and rescheduled for Sunday 6/21/20 at the same time 7:00pm. Sorry for any inconveniences. If the live stream doesn't appear in this window, I pasted a link to it down below as a backup.

https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198338577515
